talas.name: Teentaal (Tintal)
talas.description: Most common tala in Hindustani music. 16 matras in 4 vibhags of 4 each.

talas.name: Jhaptaal
talas.description: Popular tala with asymmetric grouping. 10 matras in 5 vibhags of 2 each.

talas.name: Rupak Tala
talas.description: Unique tala with 7 matras. First vibhag is 3 beats, rest are 2.

talas.name: Ektaal
talas.description: 12 matra tala used in dhrupad and khayal. 6 vibhags of 2 each.

talas.name: Jherwa
talas.description: Common tala in light classical music. 8 matras in 4 vibhags of 2 each.

talas.name: Dadra Tala
talas.description: Simple 6-beat tala used in light and semi-classical music.

talas.name: Rupak Vistaar
talas.description: Extended version of Rupak with doubled matras.
